curated-space-mono-gf-manjari: Manjari's rounded sans-serif curves stay open at the ends and friendly. Space Mono sits above it with a quirky, typewriter-like fixed width, and if you shrink that heading too far, its stencil-like gaps start to vanish.
curated-space-mono-gf-marmelad: Wire-bent and quirky, Space Mono's strokes never vary in thickness. Marmelad's sans-serif body thins slightly at the sides of its bowls, so paragraphs move along with a soft, tidy rhythm.
curated-space-mono-gf-marvel: Marvel reads tight and modern, with wide-eyed e and a shapes drawn as if with one marker. Space Mono is best at technical, fixed-width punch, while Marvel handles the running text (a status bar and tabs would suit it too) in a plain sans manner.
curated-space-mono-gf-moderustic: Space Mono brings fixed-width, code-style letters in strokes of one weight. Moderustic then follows with curves cut by a broad nib and left open, so the two sit together with a modern, slightly rough contrast.
curated-space-mono-gf-news-cycle: Space Mono draws monoline, code-flavored letters with stencil-like gaps. News Cycle's tight, dense setting and open-bottomed g give the pair a sturdy quality, say, for stickers on laptops.
curated-space-mono-gf-noto-sans-cypro-mi: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back, leaving a big gap at each end. Over a longer passage that gives a bright, professional feel, while Space Mono above it stays quirky and uninterrupted.
curated-space-mono-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese keeps its counters connected to the space around them, so lines of text feel light and unclogged. Space Mono above it reads like following a single thread.
curated-space-mono-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Noto Sans Linear A has a visibly gaping c at any size, giving it a clean look. Noto Sans Linear A would carry an engineering blog, say, comfortably, while Space Mono keeps every curve free of stress.
curated-space-mono-gf-noto-sans-manichae: Noto Sans Manichaean opens the mouths of its e crossbars. Over a longer passage it feels modern and clean, while Space Mono keeps a compass-pencil consistency, and a status bar, for instance, would be one passing home.
curated-space-mono-gf-ojuju: Ojuju reads approachable and contemporary, with wide s curves that barely curl in. Space Mono is best at neon-tube consistency in every stroke, while Ojuju does best with a gentle, rubber-cord shift in weight, as in a devops runbook.
